arStrings.szText:
{c_important}Shield Charge{/c} becomes a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill that deals {c_number}{payload:CHARGE_KNOCKBACK_A}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Shield Charge{/c} now costs {c_resource}{SF_13}{/c} Faith to Cast and an additional {c_resource}{SF_14}{/c} Faith per second.

{c_important}Shield Charge{/c} becomes a {c_important}Judicator{/c} Skill and consumes {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c} on impact, increasing the ending nova damage by {c_number}[SF_25*100|%+|]{/c} for each {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c} consumed up to {c_number}[SF_25*SF_26*100|%|]{/c}.

When {c_important}Shield Charge{/c} ends you release a Holy nova, dealing {c_number}{payload:END_BURST_B}{/c} damage and Stunning enemies for {c_number}{buffduration:STUN}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Shield Charge{/c} surges forward in a wave of energy and Knocks enemies Back, dealing {c_number}{payload:END_BURST_C}{/c} damage.
{c_important}Shield Charge{/c} grants {c_number}{SF_33}{/c} {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} whenever it hits an enemy.
{c_important}Shield Charge's{/c} damage increases by {c_number}[{SF_38} * 100|%x|]{/c} when it hits an enemy for {c_number}{SF_36}{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}[{SF_39} * 100|%x|]{/c}.
{c_important}Shield Charge{/c} grants {c_number}[SF_31 * 100 |%+|]{/c} {c_important}{u}Retribution{/u}{/c} chance while charging when you hit an enemy up to {c_number}[SF_32 * SF_31 * 100 |%+|]{/c}.
